    Is Your Electrical System Showing These Warning Signs?

    Don't ignore electrical issues — they're fire hazards. If you notice any of these, call our DEWA-certified electricians immediately.

    Frequent Tripping

    Circuit breakers tripping repeatedly — a sign of overloaded or faulty electrical circuits.

    Flickering Lights

    Lights flickering or dimming unexpectedly, indicating a loose connection or failing component.

    Burning Smell

    A burning or plastic smell from outlets or switches — a serious fire hazard that requires urgent attention.

    Outdated DB Board

    Old fuse-based distribution board that can't safely handle modern power loads and appliances.

    Hot Switch Plates

    Outlets or switch plates that feel warm to the touch — dangerously abnormal and a fire risk.

    No Earthing System

    Absence of proper earthing can cause severe electric shock risks throughout the entire property.
